label: preparing
what: A coordinated great-hall gathering or celebration appears to be in preparation: freight coordinates provisions with innkeeper and baker, baker offers sixty-four loaves if supplied wheat, and builder donates eight installed lanterns and arranges an inspection tomorrow at eighteen. It may mark my forty years as mayor, though that purpose has not been stated. Secretary knowingly assists with recording the donation and scheduling; there is insufficient evidence that neighbour or watchman is involved.
